summary: Indian stocks closed solidly higher after the Diwali break, extending their winning streak, with state-run banks leading and IT and healthcare lagging after a morning surge was partly given back.

up.summary: State-run banks led the session, with private banks and autos also bought
up.why: Cheaper energy and a sharp return of foreign buying lifted sentiment, with most of the money going into lenders.
